0022600230.text: Charlotte comes in at 3-7 on a six-game losing streak, 1-3 on the road, and sits 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 3.5 games back. Phoenix is 3-5 overall, 3-2 at home and on a two-game winning streak, and sits 12th in the West. Brandon Miller, Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Moussa Diabate are out for Charlotte, Mark Williams is out for Phoenix, and the teams split the 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Hornets winning the most recent meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
